mobile_crew_audit_a_tool: Stands for the tool name in an approval line of the audit when the entry has none.
mobile_crew_audit_answer_by: Who answered an approval in the audit: {by} is a device name from the audit entry.
mobile_crew_audit_answer_grant: An approval decided by Allow for this task, in the audit.
mobile_crew_audit_answer_mode: An approval decided by the crewmate's permission mode, in the audit.
mobile_crew_audit_answer_nobody: An approval nobody answered (it timed out, or nobody could), in the audit.
mobile_crew_audit_answer_phone: An approval answered from a phone: {node} is the start of the phone's id.
mobile_crew_audit_answer_rail: An approval a rail held (protected path, task that never auto-runs) when nobody could be asked, in the audit.
mobile_crew_audit_answer_telegram: An approval answered from Telegram: {chat} is the chat id.
mobile_crew_audit_decision_allowed: One line of the audit: a tool call was allowed. {answer} says who or what decided.
mobile_crew_audit_decision_decided: One line of the audit: a tool call was decided in a way this app does not know. {answer} says who or what decided.
mobile_crew_audit_decision_denied: One line of the audit: a tool call was denied. {answer} says who or what decided.
mobile_crew_audit_decision_timed_out: One line of the audit: a tool call was denied because nobody answered in time.
mobile_crew_audit_kind_mode_changed: Name of the audit entry kind for a permission mode change (the filter and the entry's title).
mobile_crew_audit_mode_changed: One line of the audit: a crewmate's permission mode changed. {from} and {to} are mode names, {answer} who changed it.
